name: lm358-soic8
description: onsemi LM358DR2G dual op-amp, 3-32 V single supply, SOIC-8: 1 OUT1, 2 IN1-, 3 IN1+, 4 GND, 5 IN2+, 6 IN2-, 7 OUT2, 8 VCC (LCSC C7950, JLCPCB basic); behavioural model 100 dB, 1 MHz GBW, output swings to VCC-1.5 V

spice.model:
.subckt LM358_BEHAV inp inn vcc gnd out
Rin inp inn 1e7
* 100 dB open loop, dominant pole 10 Hz -> 1 MHz GBW
Bg o1 gnd V = max(min(1e5*(V(inp,gnd)-V(inn,gnd)), V(vcc,gnd)-1.5), 0.05)
R1 o1 o2 1k
C1 o2 gnd 16u
Bo o3 gnd V = max(min(V(o2,gnd), V(vcc,gnd)-1.5), 0.05)
Rout o3 out 50
Iq vcc gnd 0.5m
.ends LM358_BEHAV

metadata.rotation_note: SOIC-8: JLCPCB's zero orientation is body-horizontal with pin 1 bottom-left; this footprint has pin 1 top-left
